general.title: Title
general.hostIpTip: Used to allow your server's IP in badge URLs and SSRF protection.
general.loggingTip: Errors shows warnings and errors only. Security events are always logged.
general.socketTip: Use the URL of a socket proxy container, never the Docker socket itself. A name such as http://socket-proxy:2375 works only when this container and the proxy share a Docker network; an IP address works only when the proxy publishes its port beyond the host’s own loopback.
general.signOutEverywhereTip: Signs out every browser and device, including this one. Use it if you think a session may have been left open or compromised. Your password does not change.
general.passwordTip: Leave blank to keep existing password. Min 8 characters. For stronger protection, consider placing the dashboard behind a dedicated authentication proxy. This built-in password is a lightweight gate, not a full authentication layer.
general.importForeignTip: Reads gethomepage and Dashy YAML files. Links and folders are added to your dashboard; widgets from the other dashboard become plain links.

appearance.keepAwakeTip: Stops the screen dimming or locking while the dashboard is open. Browsers only allow this over HTTPS, so it has no effect on a plain HTTP address.
appearance.displayModeTip: Sets the appearance of the Settings pages. It is stored in this browser, applies to this device only, and takes effect at once.
appearance.collectionTip: Leave Collection ID blank for random.
appearance.imageTip: Uploaded and linked images are stored on this server and served from it.

folder.name: Folder Name
folder.tip: Tap to add or remove apps from this folder.
folder.allInFolder: All apps are already in this folder.

app.name: Name
app.dockFull: Dock full ({max}/{max}). Remove an app first.
app.healthGlobalOff: Container checks need Docker Container Health Checks turned on in General. URL checks work without it.
app.combineTip: Every label’s value is added together and shown as one number. Turn this off to show one label at a time, starting with the highest in the list that has something to report.
app.labelValueTaken: That value is already used by another label.
app.noValuesLeft: Every fetched value already has a label.
app.labelMax: A badge shows at most {n} labels.
app.selfSignedTip: Skip TLS verification for this app's URLs. Skipping verification is insecure and should only be done if you fully understand the risks.

home.apiDownTitle: Could not connect to dashboard API
home.apiDownSub: Make sure the API container is running

toast.colorInvalid: That is not a color. Use #rrggbb or a CSS color name.
toast.importNoChange: Nothing to import — the file matches your current config.
toast.authNeedsPassword: Set a password before turning authentication on.
toast.importForeignNothing: Nothing to import from those files.
toast.importUnknownFormat: {file} is not a gethomepage or Dashy config.
toast.secretsWithheld: Enter the credential again for: {items}. It was not kept, because the request it belongs to changed.
toast.socketUrlMissing: Enter the socket proxy address, or turn Docker monitoring off.
toast.socketUrlUnverified: Saved, but the socket proxy did not answer: {reason}
toast.socketHintSharedNetwork: That name is resolved by Docker, which answers only for containers on a shared network. Put both on the same network, or use an address the proxy publishes.
toast.socketHintPublishPort: Nothing at that address answered. A socket proxy published on the host’s loopback cannot be reached from inside a container; publish it on the Docker bridge address, or put both containers on a shared network and use the proxy’s name.
toast.imageTooLarge: That image is too large for the server to accept.

confirm.clearPassword: Turn off Password Protection? The stored password is deleted, so turning it back on will need a new one.

setup.title: Set a dashboard password?
setup.sub: Optional. Without one, anyone who can reach this dashboard can use and configure it. This isn't a replacement for a dedicated auth service.
